result.topic_en: Series A and B in powers of g with coefficients built from μ, μ+1, ..., approximated by averages of (1 ± g sin(kR/2^n))^{-μ}, followed by summing the series with coefficients 1·3·5…/2·4·6… and integrating ∫dg/(g√(1−gg)) − dg/g via the substitution g = 1/x.
result.transcription:
Ist $A = 1 + \frac{\mu.\mu+1}{2.2}g^2 + \frac{\mu.\mu+1.\mu+2.\mu+3}{2.2.4.4}g^4 + \&c$
$B = \frac{\mu g}{2} + \frac{\mu.\mu+1.\mu+2}{2.2.4}g^3 + \frac{\mu\ldots\mu^4}{2.2.4.4.6}g^5 + \&c.$
und $R = \frac{1}{2}\pi$ so ist
I. $A = \left\{\begin{matrix} +\frac{1}{2}(1-g\sin\frac{1}{2}R)^{-\mu} \\ +\frac{1}{2}(1-g\sin\frac{1}{2}R)^{-\mu}\end{matrix}\right\}$ $\frac{1}{2}B = \left\{\begin{matrix} +\frac{1}{2}\sin\frac{1}{2}R(1-g\sin\frac{1}{2}R)^{-\mu} \\ -\frac{1}{2}\sin\frac{1}{2}R(1+g\sin\frac{1}{2}R)^{-\mu}\end{matrix}\right\}$
II. $A \doteq \left\{\begin{matrix} +\frac{1}{4}(1-g\sin\frac{1}{4}R)^{-\mu} + \frac{1}{4}(1-g\sin\frac{3}{4}R)^{-\mu} \\ +\frac{1}{4}(1+g\sin\frac{1}{4}R)^{-\mu} + \frac{1}{4}(1+g\sin\frac{3}{4}R)^{-\mu}\end{matrix}\right\}$
$\frac{1}{2}B = \left\{\begin{matrix} +\frac{1}{4}(1-g\sin\frac{1}{4}R)^{-\mu}\sin\frac{1}{4}R + \frac{1}{4}\sin\frac{3}{4}R(1-g\sin\frac{3}{4}R)^{-\mu} \\ -\frac{1}{4}(1-g\sin\frac{1}{4}R)^{-\mu}\sin\frac{1}{4}R - \frac{1}{4}\sin\frac{3}{4}R(1+g\sin\frac{3}{4}R)^{-\mu}\end{matrix}\right\}$
&c. semper propius.

$G = \frac{1}{2.2}g^2 + \frac{1.2.3}{2.2.4.4}gg^4 + \frac{1.2.3.4.5}{2.2.4.4.6.6}g^6$ &c.
$\frac{dG}{dg} = \frac{1}{2}g + \frac{1.2.3}{2.2.4}g^3 + \frac{1.2.3.4.5}{2.2.4.4.6}g^5 \ldots =$
$\frac{1}{2}g + \frac{1.3}{2.4}g^3 + \frac{1.3.5}{2.4.6}g^5 \ldots = e^{a\sqrt{-1}}$ [-$x$-]
$\frac{(1-g^2)^{-\frac{1}{2}} - 1}{g}$
$\frac{1}{2a}e^{\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{-1}.x\sin\frac{R}{\pi}}$
$\cos\frac{1}{2}x$
$\int\frac{dg}{g\sqrt{(1-gg)}} - \frac{dg}{g}$
sit $g = \frac{1}{x}$
$\int.\frac{dx}{x} - \frac{dx}{\sqrt{(xx-1)}}$
$= lx - l(${+$x-\sqrt{(xx-1)}$+}[-$\sqrt{(xx-1)}-x$-]$)$
$= l\frac{1}{1-\sqrt{(1-gg)}}$

methods.what: Definition of power series A and B in g with rising-factorial coefficients in μ
Approximation of A and B by averages of (1±g sin(kR/2^n))^{-μ} at equally spaced points, with successive refinements converging
Summation of the series with coefficients 1·3·5…/2·4·6… : the series equals ((1−g²)^{-1/2} − 1)/g
Integration by substitution g=1/x giving a logarithmic closed form
